name: Platform & Developer Experience (SDLC Phase 5)
description: Setting up development and deployment infrastructure — aka DevOps Foundations, Paved Road, Golden Path, Platform Engineering.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Platform & Developer Experience
capabilities.description: Establishes the paved-road infrastructure, CI/CD automation, and observability foundation developers rely on to ship safely.

services.name: CI/CD Pipeline Specification
services.contractDescription: Automated build, test, artifact publishing, and deployment pipeline workflow definition.

services.name: Infrastructure as Code Plan
services.contractDescription: Terraform / CloudFormation / Pulumi modular infrastructure automation plan.

services.name: Environments Matrix
services.contractDescription: Dev, Staging, QA, and Production environment configuration, parity rules, and data masking controls.

services.name: Secrets Management & Access Control Plan
services.contractDescription: HashiCorp Vault / AWS Secrets Manager integration, secret rotation policies, and IAM access controls.

services.name: Observability Strategy
services.contractDescription: Distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), centralized log aggregation, and metric alerting architecture.

services.name: SLO/SLA/SLI Definitions
services.contractDescription: Service Level Indicators (SLI), Service Level Objectives (SLO), and Error Budget policies.

services.name: Runbooks & Playbooks
services.contractDescription: Standard operating procedures for deployment, rollback, backup restoration, and incident triage.

checklists.name: Platform & Developer Experience (SDLC Phase 5) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for platform readiness, CI/CD automation, and observability infrastructure.

items.statement: The CI/CD pipeline specification and environments matrix consistently cover every environment from development through production.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules are version-controlled, linted, and automated with no manual environment state edits.
Secrets management solution enforces automated rotation and eliminates hardcoded credentials in repositories.
Centralized logging and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry) are configured for all microservices.
SLI/SLO metrics and error budget burn rate alerts are wired to team incident notification channels.

reviewGates.name: Platform Readiness Review
reviewGates.statement: The CI/CD Pipeline Definition and supporting platform documentation have been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Backlog & Release Planning.
reviewGates.prompt: Is the CI/CD Pipeline Definition, along with the environments, secrets management, and observability plans, sufficiently mature to support development and release?
